# dsh-translate
English · 简体中文
> A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that turns the app into a Chinese↔English translation workbench:
streaming translation, an always-on AI tutor, automatic example sentences, predicted follow-up ques
tions, source-text corrections, saved history and neural read-aloud.
## Features
### Translation
- **zh↔en with auto direction detection.** CJK-heavy input translates zh→en, Latin-heavy input en→zh

; you can also lock 中→英 or 英→中 in the header.
- **Streaming, low-latency output.** Translation calls
disable model reasoning and use compact prompts, so in local tests the first token lands in ~0.3–0.

8 s and a typical sentence finishes in ~1 s.
- **Enter translates.** `Enter` in the source box start
s a translation (pressing it again while streaming stops it); `Shift+Enter` inserts a newline. The b

ox is focused when the panel opens, so paste + Enter is the whole flow.
- **History fast path.** Rep
eating the exact same source in the same direction and study depth replays the saved record instantl
y — zero model calls, marked `已复用历史` (reused from history). **重译 / Retranslate** forces a fresh mode

l rendition.
- **Optional study mode.** Turn on 学习模式 / Study mode and the same translation call also
returns a short teaching note: 2–4 useful expressions with meanings, usage and collocations, plus g

rammar points when relevant. Off by default; the toggle is remembered.
[该节后续省略]
### Requirements
| Dependency | Notes |
| DSH | Desktop app or a self-hosted Web profile. Validated against **0.2.1-rc.5**; the external plu

gin API is still early. |
| Node.js | **>= 20** (from `engines`). |
| Model | Reuses the current pro

file's default model — no extra API key for the plugin. |
| Read-aloud, online (optional) | Python *
*3.9+** and network on first use. The plugin creates a private venv in `~/.dsh/dsh-translate/tts-ven

v` and installs `edge-tts` 7.3.1 there (20–60 s, ~20 MB); it never touches the system Python. |
| Re

ad-aloud, local (optional) | macOS `say` works out of the box. |
| Read-aloud, fallback | Browser `s
peechSynthesis` — zero dependencies. |
## How it works
- **Two halves in one plugin.** `index.js` is the host half: it mounts a prefix route at `/dsh-trans
late/api` on the host `webServer`, and reads the profile's current model from `ctx.get('llm')` plus
`ctx.get('agentDefaultModel')`. `client.js` is the browser half, loaded through the host module load
er; it registers the `sidebar.panellist` row (id `translate`, order 22) and the `main.translate` pan

el through `slots`.
- **Translation flow.** `POST /translate` is an SSE endpoint: the host resolves
`auto` direction from CJK/Latin ratio, checks the history fast path, then streams `llm.stream()` wit
h `reasoningEffort: 'off'` and sends `start` / `delta` / `done` / `error` events. The finished recor

d is saved host-side and returned in `done`.
- **Insight flow.** After `done`, the client calls `POS
T /insight` once. The host asks the model for fixed sections (`【例句】 【猜你想问】 【音标】 【译文优化】 【语法】 【拼写】 【大小
写】 【搭配与用词】`), parses rows, merges duplicates, drops placeholders and any correction whose quoted fra
gment is not actually present in the source, then writes the result back onto the matching history r

ecord.
- **Tutor flow.** `POST /ask` is a separate SSE route. The host folds the current translation
context and up to 12 prior turns into one prompt; answers are not saved. Aborting the request abort

s the model stream.
- **Read-aloud.** `POST /tts` returns binary audio: `edge-tts` (run as a separat
e process in the plugin venv) produces `audio/mpeg`, macOS `say` produces `audio/wav`, and the `x-tt
s-engine` response header reports what actually ran. The client plays the bytes and falls back to `s

peechSynthesis` when the host answers 503.
- **History durability.** Writes use a temp file + rename
and a promise queue around read-modify-write, so concurrent translations cannot overwrite each othe

r. A broken history file only costs the fast path, never the translation.
[该节后续省略]
## Data & privacy
| What | Where it goes |
| Translation prompt, study notes and insight request | Sent to the model provider configured in DSH

. |
| Tutor questions and context | Sent to the model provider configured in DSH. |
| Text you read

aloud with an **online** voice | Sent to the **Microsoft Edge TTS endpoint**. |
| Text read with the

local voice | Stays on the machine (macOS `say`). |
| History | `~/.dsh/dsh-translate/history.json`

(last 500 records). |
| History backups | `~/.dsh/dsh-translate/history.YYYY-MM-DD.bak.json` (up to

7). |
| Read-aloud environment | `~/.dsh/dsh-translate/tts-venv/` — a plugin-private Python venv. |
| Audio cache | `~/.dsh/dsh-translate/tts-cache/` — MP3/WAV keyed by engine + text + voice + speed.

|
| UI preferences | Browser `localStorage`, key `dsh-translate/prefs/v1`. |
The plugin has no telemetry, no analytics, no accounts and no API keys of its own. Tutor conversatio
ns are memory-only. Delete `tts-venv` and `tts-cache` to reset read-aloud (the next use prepares the
venv again). Because the Edge voice is used by default, read-aloud text leaves the machine unless y
ou stay on the local/browser voice (for example while offline).

## Compatibility
| Platform | Plugin | Read-aloud |
| macOS | ✅ | Edge neural voice (recommended) / local `say` (incl. Premium/Enhanced voices) / browse

r voice |
| Windows | ✅ | Edge neural voice (needs Python 3.9+ and network, auto-prepared) / browser

voice |
| Linux | ✅ | Edge neural voice (needs `python3` and `python3-venv`) / browser voice |
| Of
fline | ✅ translation needs the model service | macOS: local `say`; others: browser voice |
Validated on macOS with DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`. Windows and Linux path/Python detection is implemented per
platform but has not been regressed on real hardware — issues and PRs welcome. DSH's external plugi
n API (`webServer`, `sidebar.panellist` / `main` slots, `dsh.bundle.patch`) is still early; after a
major DSH upgrade, re-check the `dsh` field in `package.json` if the plugin stops loading. The brows
er fallback depends on the Web Speech API's English voices, whose quality varies by system.
